summary: The fix exposes five lazy device-pairing functions to Knip through named imports and an explicit runtime object, and removes an unused Activity test helper.
reasoning: I checked that #174059 replaced direct named imports in the overlay with calls through the module namespace returned by the lazy pairing factory. The fix PR reports that Knip flagged five live functions as unused, so the change addresses a CI static-analysis failure while preserving pairing behavior.
